project.name: Tirith
project.description: Tirith is a terminal security tool for developers and AI agents. It inspects commands before execution and blocks homograph URLs, pipe-to-shell installs, ANSI injection, obfuscated payloads, credential exfiltration, and malicious agent configs. Written in Rust, with 220+ detection rules and shell hooks for zsh, bash, fish, and PowerShell.
